title: Position and clamp steel workpiece bar in benchtop rapid-action sliding-jaw drill press vise onto parallels
instruction: Clamp the steel workpiece bar into the benchtop drill press vise.
context: Machinists (BLS SOC 51-4041; >340,000 workers), Tool and Die Makers (SOC 51-4111; >50,000 workers), Industrial Machinery Mechanics (SOC 49-9041; >380,000 workers), and Welders, Cutters, Solderers (SOC 51-4121; >430,000 workers)—totaling over 1,330,000 commercial manufacturing tradespeople—regularly secure raw bar stock into precision benchtop vises before drilling, tapping, or milling. The workpiece bar must be transferred from the stock rack, seated firmly down against ground steel parallels to prevent tilting under spindle thrust, and registered against the fixed jaw and lateral end stop. Once positioned, the operator actuates the rapid-action push-lever clamp handle to drive the moving jaw forward, locking the workpiece under high mechanical clamping force before clearing both hands.
setup: Benchtop rapid-action sliding-jaw drill press vise (180x120 mm base, 0.025 m bed height) centered at x 0.280 m, y 0.020 m with fixed jaw at x 0.315 m (face at x 0.305 m), lateral end stop at y -0.034 m (inner contact face at y -0.030 m matching 100 mm bar south edge), ground parallels on the bed (height 0.016 m), and moving jaw slider starting open at x 0.250 m (face at x 0.260 m). Workpiece staging rack at x 0.240 m, y 0.220 m holding a rectangular blue steel workpiece bar (100x28x25 mm, 0.55 kg, initial center z 0.775 m). Vise push-action clamp handle at x 0.190 m, y 0.020 m, rigidly bonded to the moving jaw.
scoring: Score 1.0 when workpiece bar is lifted from stock rack (z >= 0.805 m), seated flush on parallels inside the vise channel registered against end stop (dx <= 5 mm, dy <= 8 mm, dz <= 4 mm, tilt <= 3.0 deg), moving jaw clamped closed in contact with bar (effective stroke >= 16.5 mm), hands retracted clear (TCP >= 60 mm), and held stationary for 1.0 s (20 steps at 20 Hz). Partial: 0.20 bar lifted; 0.50 seated on parallels; 0.85 vise clamped. Fail (0.0): dropped off table or unclamped.
reset_notes: Place vise base at x 0.280 m, y 0.020 m. Place staging rack at x 0.240 m, y 0.220 m with workpiece bar seated in locating rails. Moving jaw open at x 0.250 m.
fidelity: Commercial 4-inch benchtop rapid-action sliding-jaw drill press vise with precision-ground fixed jaw plate, lateral end stop, ground steel parallels, heavy sliding jaw, and mechanically bonded push lever handle. Workpiece bar modelled with authentic 0.55 kg high-carbon steel inertia and friction. 100% dynamic rigid contact physics, zero synthetic pose writing.
